value.text: For the Velora V55, product code VEL-V55-2025, error E06 refers to an HDMI error, not a temperature-sensor fault as described in the Aster M55 manual. The recovery procedure for E06 involves turning off the television and the HDMI source device, unplugging both from mains power for 60 seconds, and then reconnecting the HDMI cable.
